This guide provides a step-by-step approach to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-step-step-19|setting]] up your infrastructure for seamless crypto transactions, ensuring that you retain control over your business without incurring high platform fees.

content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment processors often impose strict geographical limitations, leaving many creators unable to monetize their digital products. COREMERCH's infrastructure circumvents these issues by utilizing decentralized payment solutions like NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% per transaction compared to Gumroad's 10%. This significant fee difference can mean the retention of $921 on 100 sales of a $97 product monthly, providing you with a more sustainable business model.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before getting started, ensure you have essential tools ready. You will need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, access to Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and a NOWPayments account for crypto transaction processing. Additionally, consider using Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. These resources will form the backbone of your sovereign digital commerce infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish a robust payment and delivery pipeline, first, deploy your selected stack—either the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack from COREMERCH. Integrate NOWPayments for automated crypto payment processing, ensuring that your customers can pay with over 300 cryptocurrencies. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery of your digital products upon payment confirmation, providing customers with instant access while maintaining full ownership of your data.
Reduce transaction fees to just 0.5% with NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your stack is deployed and your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it’s time to go live. Promote your products through your social media channels or a dedicated website. Direct potential buyers to your store where they can complete transactions using crypto. Monitor your first transaction through NOWPayments, ensuring that the webhook fires correctly upon payment confirmation, which will trigger the delivery of your digital product automatically.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your infrastructure operational, focus on scaling your business. Use analytics tools to track sales and customer engagement, and consider expanding your product offerings. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides additional resources, including blueprints and templates, enabling you to efficiently manage multiple products while retaining complete control over your digital commerce stack. Continuous improvement and adaptation are key to maximizing your success.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Retain complete ownership of your product and data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a wide audience. This flexibility ensures that you can accept payments in various digital currencies, enhancing your market reach.
